theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_covector
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), ∃ β : Covector (Euclid (m + 1)) m, ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), β (i.removeNth (fun l : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) = if i = j then (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ) else 0
